affected_rows: 0 rows carry a wrong figure; 1 printed row per Sarawak year is MISSING (the head itself)
defect: Sarawak prints a FOURTH revenue head, `Pemberian Kerajaan Persekutuan dan Bayaran Balik` (FY2020: 248.34), which is not emitted as a row. `revenue_total` (10,646.69) is correct, but tax + nontax + nonrevenue = 10,398.35 falls short by that head, so Sarawak's revenue components do not sum to its total.
diagnosis: Surfaced by the DOSM cross-check (sources/dosm/data/_crosscheck_state_finance_vs_audited.csv): DOSM reports Sarawak non-revenue receipts as 279.09, and 30.75 + 248.34 = 279.09 exactly - DOSM folds the head into non-revenue receipts, proving the printed head exists and our figure for it is right. The validator already uses it in the four-head reconciliation proof, so the head is recognised during checking but never written to the fact file.
why_unfixed: Needs a revenue-head row emitted under a conformed code (e.g. revenue_federal_grants) plus a decision on whether other states' equivalent heads conform to the same code - a dictionary change, not taken unilaterally. sources/dosm/pipeline/crosscheck_state_finance.py already carries the COMBINES entry that will re-adjudicate the DOSM comparison to DEFINITIONAL once the code exists.
impact_on_data: No figure in the panel is wrong. Do not derive Sarawak revenue by summing components; use revenue_total.

affected_rows: unknown - a latent tokeniser defect, not a located row set
defect: A figure printed EXACTLY ONE SPACE after the previous figure is dropped by `lkan_state_parser._value_tokens`.
diagnosis: `_NUM_RE` allows one optional space after the sign, so when two figures are one space apart the scanner starts the second match ON that space; its preceding character is then the last digit of the first figure and the date / section-number guard discards it.  Seen on Sarawak CMD.43.2018 J4.14, where every row lost `27.5 25.8 35.2`.
why_unfixed: The root fix (trim leading white space before applying the guard) was implemented and DELIBERATELY REVERTED: it moved roughly 2,000 rows across all 13 states, raised the refusal count, and degraded the frozen Selangor regression.  It needs its own pass with the column clustering retuned alongside it.
impact_on_data: Mostly percentage and PERUBAHAN columns, which are not extracted anyway.  Where it hits a money column the row is marked `column_geometry=incomplete_row`, so no figure is wrong - some are absent.
